flagged.evidence: The item says, “Thus a genuinely distributionally harmonic locally integrable function has no interior corner.” Its cited dependency thm-weyl-lemma-for-the-laplacian says only that “there is a unique smooth harmonic h with T=T_h,” i.e. a smooth representative. For example, on R let f=0 except f(0)=1. Then f is locally integrable and T_f=0, hence ΔT_f=0, but this pointwise representative is discontinuous and not smooth at 0. The proof establishes representative regularity, not the asserted pointwise regularity of every locally integrable representative.
